items.label: Pass the 15-heart door in Event Horizon
items.note: Needs all 8 blue hearts plus every B-Side except Core's, though it is bypassable.

items.label: Moon Berry
items.note: In the final checkpoint: go left after the last power box, then a death exploit into a long jellyfish room. Earns Wow.

items.label: Clear Farewell
items.note: The final room is the longest in the game — expect 1.5 to 2 hours on a first attempt. Earns Farewell.
